name: Machine Maintenance Report
report_script:
def execute(filters=None):
    if not filters:
        filters = {}

    # Columns for the report
    columns = [
        {"label": "Machine", "fieldname": "machine_name", "fieldtype": "Link", "options":"Item", "width": 150},
        {"label": "Maintenance Date", "fieldname": "maintenance_date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 120},
        {"label": "Technician", "fieldname": "technician", "fieldtype": "Link", "options":"Employee", "width": 150},
        {"label": "Status", "fieldname": "status", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 100},
        {"label": "Cost", "fieldname": "cost", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
        {"label": "Consolidated", "fieldname": "consolidated", "fieldtype": "Check", "width": 100},
    ]

    # Build conditions based on filters
    conditions = []
    if filters.get("machine_name"):
        conditions.append("machine_name = '{}'".format(filters.get("machine_name")))
    if filters.get("technician"):
        conditions.append("technician = '{}'".format(filters.get("technician")))
    if filters.get("from_date"):
        conditions.append("maintenance_date >= '{}'".format(filters.get("from_date")))
    if filters.get("to_date"):
        conditions.append("maintenance_date <= '{}'".format(filters.get("to_date")))

    where_clause = " AND ".join(conditions) if conditions else "1=1"

    # Consolidated checkbox
    consolidated_flag = int(filters.get("consolidated") or 0)

    if consolidated_flag:
        # Group by machine_name and sum cost
        data = frappe.db.sql("""
            SELECT
                machine_name,
                NULL AS maintenance_date,
                NULL AS technician,
                NULL AS status,
                SUM(cost) AS cost,
                1 AS consolidated
            FROM `tabMachine Maintenance`
            WHERE {where_clause}
            GROUP BY machine_name
        """.format(where_clause=where_clause), as_dict=True)
    else:
        # Show individual maintenance entries
        data = frappe.db.sql("""
            SELECT
                machine_name,
                maintenance_date,
                technician,
                status,
                cost,
                0 AS consolidated
            FROM `tabMachine Maintenance`
            WHERE {where_clause}
            ORDER BY maintenance_date DESC
        """.format(where_clause=where_clause), as_dict=True)

    return columns, data
